The '''[[1932 in association football|1932]]–[[1933 in association football|33]] season''' was the 41st season of [[The Football League]].

==Final league tables==
Match results are drawn from [https://www.rsssf.org/engpaul/FLA/1932-33.html The Rec.Sport.Soccer Statistics Foundation] website<ref name="rsssf">{{cite web |url=https://www.rsssf.org/engpaul/FLA/1932-33.html |title=England 1932-33 |publisher=Rec.Sport.Soccer Statistics Foundation|access-date=2010-02-24}}</ref> and Rothmans<ref name="Rothmans">Ian Laschke: ''Rothmans Book of Football League Records 1888–89 to 1978–79''. Macdonald and Jane’s, London & Sydney, 1980.</ref> for the First Division and from ''Rothmans'' for the Second Division and for the two Third Divisions.

From the 1922–23 season onwards, re-election was required of the bottom two teams of both the Third Division North and Third Division South leagues.<ref name=" Rothmans"/>

*The Blackpool v Chelsea match at [[Bloomfield Road]] on the 29th of October was played in terrible conditions, with a quagmire pitch and ferocious rain and wind. Only eight Chelsea players started the second half, and they finished the match with only six players.<ref>{{cite book |last1=Ward |first1=Andrew |title=Football's Strangest Matches: Extraordinary but true stories from over a century of football |date=2010 |publisher=Portico |location=London |isbn=1907554084 |pages=38–39}}</ref>
